items.pred_sql:
SELECT

FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

  t1.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02'

FROM TB_CTRT t
WHERE substr(t.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2025'

FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE c.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250701' AND '20251231'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT t
WHERE t.MON_PRM >= 500000

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1

FROM TB_CUST c
WHERE c.VIP_GRD_CD = 'V1'

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.MKT_AGR_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS AGR_RATIO
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CLM_STAT_CD = '40'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CMPL_CNT
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
WHERE substr(t.RCPT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PROD AS t1
WHERE
  NOT t1.SALE_END_DT IS NULL

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PROD AS t1
WHERE
  t1.RNW_YN = 'Y'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_AGNT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.RSGN_DT IS NULL

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_BRCH AS t1

SELECT
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT MAX(c.TOT_INSD_AMT) AS MAX_TOT_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CTRT c

SELECT
  SUM(t1.CLM_AMT) AS "청구금액_합계"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1

SELECT
  SUM(t1.PAY_AMT) AS "지급금액_합계"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PAY AS t1
WHERE
  t1.DLQ_YN = 'Y'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PAY AS t1
WHERE
  t1.DLQ_YN = 'Y' AND t1.DLQ_DAYS > 30

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
WHERE
  t1.RISK_SCR >= 80

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
WHERE
  t1.UW_RSLT_CD = 'D'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PROD AS t1
WHERE
  t1.PROD_TYP_CD = 'C'

SELECT COUNT(c.CUST_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM TB_CUST c
WHERE c.RGN_CD = '11'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.FRAUD_SCR > 70

SELECT c.CTRT_NO, c.TOT_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CTRT c
ORDER BY c.TOT_INSD_AMT DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CVRG AS t1

SELECT
  AVG(t1.SATIS_SCR) AS "만족도점수_평균"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CTRT_STAT_CD = '05'

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "모집채널",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.CHNL_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'CHNL'
GROUP BY
  t1.CHNL_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT
    c.CTRT_STAT_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CNT,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTRT), 0) AS RATIO
FROM TB_CTRT c
GROUP BY c.CTRT_STAT_CD
ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT
  t3.BRCH_NM AS "지점명",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_AGNT AS t2
  ON t1.AGNT_ID = t2.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH AS t3
  ON t2.BRCH_CD = t3.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY
  t3.BRCH_NM
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "상품유형",
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_PROD AS t2
  ON t1.PROD_CD = t2.PROD_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t2.PROD_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP'
GROUP BY
  t2.PROD_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "고객등급",
  AVG(t1.TOT_INSD_AMT) AS "총가입금액_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_CUST AS t2
  ON t1.CUST_ID = t2.CUST_ID
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t2.VIP_GRD_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'VIP_GRD'
GROUP BY
  t2.VIP_GRD_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS CTRT_YM,
    COUNT(*) AS NEW_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2025'
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
ORDER BY CTRT_YM

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "청구유형",
  SUM(t1.PAY_AMT) AS "지급금액_합계"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.CLM_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'CLM_TYP'
GROUP BY
  t1.CLM_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM
ORDER BY
  SUM(t1.PAY_AMT) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    substr(c.DEDT_DT, 1, 4) AS PAY_YEAR,
    SUM(c.PAY_AMT) AS TOTAL_PAY_AMT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'
GROUP BY substr(c.DEDT_DT, 1, 4)
ORDER BY PAY_YEAR

SELECT
  t1.CTGY_CD AS "민원유형코드",
  AVG(t1.SATIS_SCR) AS "만족도점수_평균"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.PROC_STAT_CD = '01'
GROUP BY
  t1.CTGY_CD

SELECT
  t1.GRD_CD AS "설계사등급코드",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_AGNT AS t1
GROUP BY
  t1.GRD_CD

SELECT c.RGN_CD, COUNT(*) AS CUST_CNT
FROM TB_CUST c
GROUP BY c.RGN_CD
ORDER BY CUST_CNT DESC

SELECT
  t1.PROD_CD AS "상품코드",
  t1.BASE_PRM AS "기준보험료",
  t1.PROD_NM AS "상품명",
  t1.PROD_TYP_CD AS "상품유형코드",
  t1.SALE_STRT_DT AS "판매개시일자",
  t1.SALE_END_DT AS "판매종료일자"
FROM TB_PROD AS t1
ORDER BY
  t1.BASE_PRM DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    c.CHNL_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS TOT_PAY_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.DLQ_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DLQ_CNT,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.DLQ_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DLQ_RATE
FROM TB_PAY p
JOIN TB_CTRT c ON c.CTRT_NO = p.CTRT_NO
GROUP BY c.CHNL_CD
ORDER BY DLQ_RATE DESC

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "상품유형",
  SUM(t3.INSD_AMT) AS "담보가입금액_합계"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_PROD AS t2
  ON t1.PROD_CD = t2.PROD_CD
JOIN TB_CVRG AS t3
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t3.CTRT_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t2.PROD_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP'
GROUP BY
  t2.PROD_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM
ORDER BY
  SUM(t3.INSD_AMT) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.HOSP_NM, COUNT(*) AS CLM_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
GROUP BY c.HOSP_NM
ORDER BY CLM_CNT DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  t1.DIAG_CD AS "진단코드",
  AVG(t1.PAY_AMT) AS "지급금액_평균"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'
GROUP BY
  t1.DIAG_CD
ORDER BY
  AVG(t1.PAY_AMT) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  t4.BRCH_NM AS "지점명",
  AVG(t1.RISK_SCR) AS "위험점수_평균"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
JOIN TB_CTRT AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
JOIN TB_AGNT AS t3
  ON t2.AGNT_ID = t3.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH AS t4
  ON t3.BRCH_CD = t4.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY
  t4.BRCH_NM

SELECT
    c.CLM_TYP_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CLM_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260630'
GROUP BY c.CLM_TYP_CD
ORDER BY CLM_CNT DESC

SELECT c.CHNL_CD, COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_CUST u ON u.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
WHERE u.VIP_GRD_CD IN ('V1','V2')
GROUP BY c.CHNL_CD
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    p.PROD_TYP_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LAPSE_CNT,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS LAPSE_RATE
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD
ORDER BY LAPSE_RATE DESC

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_AGNT AS t1
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "납입방법",
  SUM(t1.PAY_AMT) AS "수납금액_합계"
FROM TB_PAY AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.PAY_MTHD_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PAY_MTHD'
GROUP BY
  t1.PAY_MTHD_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  t1.CTGY_CD AS "민원유형코드",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
GROUP BY
  t1.CTGY_CD

SELECT b.BRCH_CD, b.BRCH_NM, COUNT(c.CTRT_NO) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = a.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY b.BRCH_CD, b.BRCH_NM
HAVING COUNT(c.CTRT_NO) >= 100
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
WHERE
  t1.MON_PRM >= 300000

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) AS CTRT_YEAR,
    COUNT(*) AS NEW_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) IN ('2025', '2026')
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4)
ORDER BY CTRT_YEAR

SELECT
    c.VIP_GRD_CD,
    COUNT(t.TCKT_ID) AS CMPL_CNT
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
JOIN TB_CUST c ON c.CUST_ID = t.CUST_ID
GROUP BY c.VIP_GRD_CD
ORDER BY c.VIP_GRD_CD

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "인수심사결과",
  AVG(t1.RISK_SCR) AS "위험점수_평균"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.UW_RSLT_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'UW_RSLT'
GROUP BY
  t1.UW_RSLT_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "상품유형",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_UW AS t1
JOIN TB_CTRT AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
JOIN TB_PROD AS t3
  ON t2.PROD_CD = t3.PROD_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t3.PROD_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP'
WHERE
  t1.UW_RSLT_CD = 'C'
GROUP BY
  t3.PROD_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS CTRT_YM,
    COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT,
    SUM(c.MON_PRM) AS TOT_MON_PRM
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE c.CHNL_CD = '30'
  AND substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
ORDER BY CTRT_YM

SELECT
  t1.CTRT_NO AS "계약번호",
  t1.CUST_ID AS "계약자고객ID",
  t1.PROD_CD AS "상품코드",
  t1.CTRT_DT AS "계약체결일자",
  t1.TOT_INSD_AMT AS "총가입금액",
  t1.CHNL_CD AS "모집채널코드"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_CVRG AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
ORDER BY
  t2.INSD_AMT DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  AVG(t1.PAY_AMT) AS "지급금액_평균"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'

SELECT
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PAY AS t1
WHERE
  t1.DLQ_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT t
WHERE substr(t.EXPR_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.CHNL_CD = '30' THEN 1 END) AS DIRECT_CNT,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.CHNL_CD = '30' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DIRECT_RATIO
FROM TB_CTRT c

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "상품유형",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_PROD AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.PROD_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP'
GROUP BY
  t1.PROD_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  t4.BRCH_NM AS "지점명",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
JOIN TB_CTRT AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
JOIN TB_AGNT AS t3
  ON t2.AGNT_ID = t3.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH AS t4
  ON t3.BRCH_CD = t4.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY
  t4.BRCH_NM
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "성별",
  AVG(t3.MAX_AGE) AS "최대가입연령_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_CUST AS t2
  ON t1.CUST_ID = t2.CUST_ID
JOIN TB_PROD AS t3
  ON t1.PROD_CD = t3.PROD_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t2.GNDR_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'GNDR'
GROUP BY
  t2.GNDR_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "접수채널",
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t1
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t1.CHNL_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'CHNL'
WHERE
  t1.CTGY_CD = '06' AND t1.PROC_STAT_CD = '01'
GROUP BY
  t1.CHNL_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

SELECT
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT
  AVG(t1.MON_PRM) AS "월납보험료_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1

WITH cnt AS (
    SELECT
        p.PROD_TYP_CD AS PROD_TYP_CD,
        c.CHNL_CD AS CHNL_CD,
        COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.PROD_TYP_CD ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RNK
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
    GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD, c.CHNL_CD
)
SELECT
    cnt.PROD_TYP_CD,
    cnt.CHNL_CD,
    cnt.CTRT_CNT
FROM cnt
WHERE cnt.RNK = 1
ORDER BY cnt.PROD_TYP_CD

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250630' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LAST_YR_CNT,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260630' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS THIS_YR_CNT
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    WHERE c.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20260630'
)
SELECT
    b.LAST_YR_CNT,
    b.THIS_YR_CNT,
    CAST(b.THIS_YR_CNT - b.LAST_YR_CNT AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.LAST_YR_CNT, 0) * 100 AS GROWTH_RATE_PCT
FROM base b

SELECT
  t1.CLM_NO AS "청구번호",
  t1.PAY_AMT AS "지급금액",
  t1.CTRT_NO AS "계약번호",
  t1.CLM_TYP_CD AS "청구유형코드",
  t1.ACDN_DT AS "사고일자",
  t1.CLM_DT AS "청구접수일자"
FROM TB_CLM AS t1
WHERE
  t1.PAY_AMT >= 3
ORDER BY
  t1.PAY_AMT DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH agnt_cnt AS (
    SELECT
        a.BRCH_CD,
        a.AGNT_ID,
        a.AGNT_NM,
        COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
    GROUP BY a.BRCH_CD, a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ac.BRCH_CD,
        ac.AGNT_ID,
        ac.AGNT_NM,
        ac.CTRT_CNT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ac.BRCH_CD
            ORDER BY ac.CTRT_CNT DESC, ac.AGNT_ID ASC
        ) AS RNK
    FROM agnt_cnt ac
)
SELECT
    b.BRCH_CD,
    b.BRCH_NM,
    r.AGNT_ID,
    r.AGNT_NM,
    r.CTRT_CNT
FROM ranked r
JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = r.BRCH_CD
WHERE r.RNK = 1
ORDER BY b.BRCH_CD

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.CLM_NO,
    c.PAY_AMT,
    c.FRAUD_SCR,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY c.PAY_AMT DESC) AS pct_grp
  FROM TB_CLM c
)
SELECT
  AVG(r.FRAUD_SCR) AS avg_fraud_score_top10pct
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.pct_grp = 1

WITH complain_cust AS (
    SELECT t.CUST_ID
    FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
    GROUP BY t.CUST_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
ctrt_cnt AS (
    SELECT c.CUST_ID, COUNT(*) AS ctrt_count
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    JOIN complain_cust cc ON cc.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
    GROUP BY c.CUST_ID
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(cc.ctrt_count) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_ctrt_count
FROM ctrt_cnt cc

SELECT
  cd1.CD_NM AS "상품유형",
  AVG(t1.RVIV_CNT) AS "부활횟수_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_PROD AS t2
  ON t1.PROD_CD = t2.PROD_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_COMM_CD AS cd1
  ON t2.PROD_TYP_CD = cd1.CD AND cd1.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP'
WHERE
  t1.CTRT_STAT_CD = '05'
GROUP BY
  t2.PROD_TYP_CD,
  cd1.CD_NM

WITH recent AS (
  SELECT CLM_TYP_CD, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM TB_CLM
  WHERE CLM_DT BETWEEN '20250829' AND '20260828'
  GROUP BY CLM_TYP_CD
),
prev AS (
  SELECT CLM_TYP_CD, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM TB_CLM
  WHERE CLM_DT BETWEEN '20240829' AND '20250828'
  GROUP BY CLM_TYP_CD
)
SELECT
  r.CLM_TYP_CD,
  r.cnt AS recent_cnt,
  COALESCE(p.cnt, 0) AS prev_cnt
FROM recent r
LEFT JOIN prev p ON p.CLM_TYP_CD = r.CLM_TYP_CD
WHERE r.cnt > COALESCE(p.cnt, 0)
ORDER BY r.CLM_TYP_CD

SELECT
  SUM(t1.TOT_INSD_AMT) AS "총가입금액_합계"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1

SELECT
  t1.CTRT_NO AS "계약번호",
  t1.MON_PRM AS "월납보험료",
  t1.PROD_CD AS "상품코드",
  t1.PAY_TERM_YR AS "납입기간년수",
  t1.CHNL_CD AS "모집채널코드",
  t1.TERM_DT AS "해지일자"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
ORDER BY
  t1.MON_PRM DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    t.CHNL_CD,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.CTRT_STAT_CD IN ('01','05') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS RETENTION_RATE
FROM TB_CTRT t
GROUP BY t.CHNL_CD
ORDER BY RETENTION_RATE DESC

WITH dlq_ctrt AS (
  SELECT p.CTRT_NO
  FROM TB_PAY p
  WHERE p.DLQ_YN = 'Y'
  GROUP BY p.CTRT_NO
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS target_ctrt_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lapsed_cnt,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS lapse_rate
FROM dlq_ctrt d
JOIN TB_CTRT c ON c.CTRT_NO = d.CTRT_NO

WITH RankedUW AS (
    SELECT
        u.CTRT_NO,
        u.RISK_SCR,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY u.RISK_SCR DESC) AS risk_quartile
    FROM TB_UW u
),
TopRisk AS (
    SELECT r.CTRT_NO
    FROM RankedUW r
    WHERE r.risk_quartile = 1
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLM c WHERE c.CTRT_NO = t.CTRT_NO
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS claim_ratio_top25pct_risk
FROM TopRisk t

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS ym,
    COUNT(*) AS ctrt_cnt
  FROM TB_CTRT c
  WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'
  GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    ym,
    ctrt_cnt,
    LAG(ctrt_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS prev_cnt
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT ym, ctrt_cnt, prev_cnt
FROM compared
WHERE prev_cnt IS NOT NULL AND ctrt_cnt > prev_cnt
ORDER BY ym

SELECT c.CLM_TYP_CD,
       CAST(SUM(c.PAY_AMT) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(c.CLM_AMT), 0) AS pay_ratio
FROM TB_CLM c
GROUP BY c.CLM_TYP_CD
ORDER BY pay_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    b.BRCH_CD,
    b.BRCH_NM,
    COUNT(t.TCKT_ID) AS CMPL_CNT
FROM TB_BRCH b
LEFT JOIN TB_AGNT a
    ON a.BRCH_CD = b.BRCH_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_CTRT c
    ON c.AGNT_ID = a.AGNT_ID
LEFT JOIN TB_CS_TCKT t
    ON t.CTRT_NO = c.CTRT_NO
    AND substr(t.RCPT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'
GROUP BY b.BRCH_CD, b.BRCH_NM
HAVING COUNT(t.TCKT_ID) < 30
ORDER BY CMPL_CNT ASC

SELECT
  AVG(t2.DLQ_DAYS) AS "연체일수_평균"
FROM TB_CTRT AS t1
JOIN TB_PAY AS t2
  ON t1.CTRT_NO = t2.CTRT_NO
WHERE
  t2.DLQ_DAYS >= 2

SELECT DISTINCT c.CUST_ID, t.CTRT_NO
FROM TB_CUST c
JOIN TB_CS_TCKT t ON t.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
WHERE c.TELNO = '010-1234-5678'

SELECT
  t1.CUST_ID AS "고객ID",
  t1.CUST_NM AS "고객명",
  t1.GNDR_CD AS "성별코드",
  t1.ZIP_CD AS "우편번호",
  t1.ADDR AS "주소",
  t1.TELNO AS "휴대전화번호"
FROM TB_CUST AS t1
LIMIT 200

SELECT c.CUST_ID, c.CUST_NM, c.BRDT
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT c.CLM_NO, c.DIAG_CD
FROM TB_CLM c
ORDER BY c.CLM_NO

SELECT c.EMAIL
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT t.TCKT_ID, t.CNTN
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
